attribution_sentence: Kernel accumulation order is not the cause. On identical inputs the WASM generic kernels differ from the native AVX2/tinyBLAS kernels by at most 1.43e-6 (fc1) and 9.54e-7 (fc2), and both builds quantize identical inputs to identical Q8 bytes. The native kernel fed the WASM-captured inputs reproduces the full natural error (fc1 5.73e-4, fc2 0.00331). The amplification comes from activation quantization: input differences of about 1e-6 inherited from earlier layers change one fc1 Q8_0 block scale (one FP16 rounding step, about 4.9e-4 relative) and 38 fc2 Q8_K scales plus 3 quantized values.

candidate.reason: A native-order WASM IQ4_NL/IQ4_XS kernel (exact int lanes, fmaf, AVX2 hsum order) was emulated and reproduces native bit-exactly on the same input, but its expected natural effect is unchanged: fc2 stays 0.00331 (fails), fc1 stays 5.73e-4. It would remove only the <=1.4e-6 kernel component, so no default-off candidate is recommended from this evidence.
